Portable, self-contained distribution of the **Ruby** interpreter. This repository is consumed by the Embedbits Platform Artifact Handler to locate, download, verify, and configure a Ruby interpreter in downstream embedded build tooling — primarily to run the **CMock** mock generator and the **Unity** test-runner generator scripts without depending on whatever Ruby is (or is not) installed on the host machine.

This repository is split into three branches/refs by role — the `main` (`master`) branch you are reading now holds only this documentation; the handler scripts live on the `Core` branch, and versioned binaries are published as GitHub Releases anchored to the `Bin` branch.

---

## Repository contents

```
main / master
└── README.md                     ← This document — no other content

Core
├── ArtifactConfig.cmake          ← Artifact metadata (name, version constraints, asset naming)
└── CMakeRubyDefaults.cmake       ← Ruby integration logic (interpreter path setup)

Bin  (anchor branch — no tracked binary files)
└── (empty commits only; each release tag points here)
```

---

## Role in the platform

```
Upstream                                   GitHub (Embedbits)
──────────────────────────────────────    ──────────────────────────────────────────
oneclick/rubyinstaller2                    Artifact-ruby
  rubyinstaller-<ver>-<rev>-x64.7z   ──►     main / master →  README only (this document)
Homebrew/homebrew-portable-ruby              Core          →  ArtifactConfig.cmake, CMakeRubyDefaults.cmake
  portable-ruby-<ver>.<os>.bottle.tar.gz     Bin           →  Anchor branch (empty commits)
                                             Releases      →  ruby-<version>-<platform>.zip + .hash
                                                               tagged Bin/<version>-<platform>
```

Ruby upstream only publishes source code, so `Ruby_Importer.sh` combines two well-maintained sources of portable builds and repacks both to `.zip` with the Ruby installation root (`bin/`, `lib/`, ...) at the top level of the archive.

---

## Supported platforms

| Platform code | Target | Upstream source |
|---|---|---|
| `Win` | Windows x86_64 (UCRT) | [RubyInstaller2](https://github.com/oneclick/rubyinstaller2) — portable `.7z` archive (no installer, no MSYS2 DevKit) |
| `Unix` | Linux x86_64 (glibc) | [Homebrew portable-ruby](https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-portable-ruby) — `x86_64_linux` bottle |
| `DarwinARM` | macOS arm64 (11+) | [Homebrew portable-ruby](https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-portable-ruby) — `arm64_big_sur` bottle |

> **Version coverage differs per platform.** RubyInstaller2 publishes every Ruby release, whereas Homebrew only builds the versions Homebrew itself vendors. A given version may therefore exist as `Bin/<version>-Win` only. Pick a version available for every platform your project needs (e.g. `3.4.5`).

Where an upstream repackages the same Ruby version (RubyInstaller `-<rev>` suffix, Homebrew `_<rev>` suffix), only the highest revision is imported. Upstream prereleases are ignored.

---

## Branch structure

| Branch / Ref | Content |
|---|---|
| `main` / `master` | This README only — no functional content |
| `Core` | CMake handler scripts for consuming the artifact |
| `Bin` | Anchor branch only — no binaries are committed here |
| Release tag `Bin/<version>-<platform>` | GitHub Release carrying the `.zip` archive and its `.hash` checksum file |

> **Note:** On a Git host without a Releases API (Azure DevOps), the same importer commits the `.zip` + `.hash` directly to the `Bin` branch and tags that commit `Bin/<version>-<platform>`. The CMake handler resolves either form transparently.

---

## Fetching a release

```bash
gh release download Bin/3.4.5-Unix --repo Embedbits/Artifact-ruby --pattern "ruby-3.4.5-Unix.*"
```

---

## Package layout

```
ruby-<version>-<platform>.zip
├── bin/                          ← ruby / ruby.exe, gem, bundle, ...
├── lib/                          ← standard library and default gems
└── ...
```

---

## Versioning

Artifact versions correspond directly to **Ruby release versions**:

```
3.3.8, 3.4.5, 4.0.7, ...
```

---

## Notes

- **No installation required** — both upstream builds are relocatable and run from any directory.
- The Windows build does **not** include the MSYS2 DevKit, so gems with native C extensions cannot be compiled with it. Pure-Ruby tools such as CMock and the Unity scripts do not need it.
- **Offline use** is supported once the artifact is cached locally.
